gates.name: Baseline and fixture gate
required: Branch drift classified
Full MAF and optional-surface discovery complete
Resolved package graph and warning baseline captured
1.13 cross-version fixtures captured and hashed
File-tool inventory captured
Rollback state snapshot documented

gates.name: Approval security and state gate
required: Approval response binding proven active on every provider path
Initial mixed-approval parity behavior explicit
Per-ID decisions or strict one-request invariant proven
Random request-ID fallback removed
Native 1.15 restart continuation passes
Forged, substituted, replayed, and cross-session approvals fail closed
Legacy 1.13 pending approvals have a tested migration outcome
Attachment scrub preserves approval binding state

gates.name: Runtime semantics gate
required: Full runtime returns authoritative terminal handoff output
Intermediate activity remains visible but is not machine output
Tool-call/result and reasoning/text ordering pass
Returned response and persisted history agree
Handoff depth enforcement remains effective
Session and workflow checkpoint cross-version outcomes are explicit
Session persistence failures are diagnosable
Required-finalizer semantics remain correct
gates.failure_action: Do not remove runtime workarounds or deploy

gates.name: Final closure gate
required: File and capability security regression passes
A2A smoke test passes
Resolved package graph contains one intended release train
Optional feature register is complete
Warning suppressions are narrowed and justified
Full build, tests, and real-provider validation pass
Canary and rollback rehearsal pass
Legacy approval bridge is disabled or has a dated removal plan
Execution report maps every requirement to proof
